### Improved
- Improvements and bug fixes.

### Improved
- Improved the license activation system to support newly issued license keys.

### Improved
- Updated our licensing system to support new license keys and ensure smoother activation.

### Improved
- Faster and more reliable license server connection on networks with slow IPv6 routing.
- License verification timeouts and error messages have been improved for better stability.

### Improved
- License activation and verification are now much faster and more reliable, especially on internet connections with IPv6 issues.
- Connection timeouts have been increased to prevent license sync failures on slower internet connections.
- The system log now provides clearer error details if the license server cannot be reached.

### Improved
- Increased the connection timeout when syncing licenses to prevent errors on slower internet connections.
- Offline-generated license keys are now protected from being automatically overwritten by lower-tier plans.
- License connection errors are now displayed in the main app log to make troubleshooting easier.
### Fixed
- Fixed connection timeouts during license activation on network routers with broken IPv6 configurations.

### Improved
- The app now automatically hides purchase and trial buttons if the online store is temporarily closed.
- Offline license keys are now protected from being overwritten by the server unless a better plan is available.

### Improved
- The app now checks for license updates and plan changes every minute instead of every five minutes.
- Offline license keys are now safely preserved and will not be overwritten by the server unless you upgrade to a better plan.
- Detailed license status and server connection messages are now displayed directly in the app's log.
- Purchase and trial buttons will now automatically hide if online buying is temporarily paused on the server.

### Improved
- License updates and plan changes are now applied much faster, checking every minute instead of every five minutes.
- The application log now displays clear status updates regarding your license checks.

### Improved
- License updates and plan changes are now detected much faster, checking every minute instead of every five minutes.
- The application log now displays clear status messages regarding your license checks and plan updates.

### Improved
- Improvements and bug fixes.

### Improved
- Improvements and bug fixes.

### Improved

### Improved
- Improvements and bug fixes.

### Improved
- Your license plan now updates automatically right away when changed by an administrator, without needing to restart the app.

### New
- AI Voice Check (Pro): Gemini listens to each line to automatically confirm and correct male and female voices.
- Video Recap (Pro): Automatically creates a short 10 to 20 minute summary video from long recordings.
- Thumbnail Maker (Pro): Design custom video thumbnails with proper Khmer text shaping and ready-to-use styles.
- Voice Cloning (Pro): Connect your own RunPod voice server to generate custom Khmer voice-overs.
- Free Trial Watermark: Trial videos now include a watermark on every processed file.
### Improved
- Live System Monitor: The status bar now displays real-time CPU, RAM, and GPU usage.
- Settings Favorites: Save your preferred conversion settings and reload them anytime.
- Video Length Limits: Professional licenses now support videos up to 10 minutes long.
- UI Theme: Updated to a clean dark theme with dark title bars across all windows.
### Fixed
- License Activation: Improved online subscription support and license key verification.
- Speaker Split: Better detection and separation when a man and a woman speak within the same line.

### New
- Added AI-powered voice checking where Gemini listens to each dialogue line to correctly distinguish male and female voices.
- Added a video recap maker to automatically turn long videos into shorter summary clips [Professional].
- Added a thumbnail maker to design video cover images with correctly shaped Khmer text [Professional].
- Added online subscription support with instant purchase and activation [Trial / Professional].
### Improved
- Upgraded the voice-over system to automatically split and dub lines containing both a male and a female speaker.
- Added real-time CPU, RAM, and GPU usage monitoring in the status bar.
- Updated the video editor with flexible cropping and watermark support for free trial videos [Trial].
### Fixed
- Fixed an issue where very long videos exceeded plan limits by adding clearer length warnings and video caps.
- Fixed an issue with Khmer text rendering in video subtitles and titles using advanced font shaping.

### New
- Added AI-powered voice checking where Gemini listens to each line to confirm male or female speakers.
- Added a professional thumbnail maker with support for Khmer text styles and layout options [Pro].
- Added video recap creation to turn long videos into shorter summaries [Pro].
- Added online subscription support with KHQR payments and license restoration.
- Added support for RunPod voice servers to automatically start and stop during video conversion.
### Improved
- Updated the speech recognition and speaker detection to automatically split lines when both a man and a woman speak.
- Improved the video player and overlay positioning with flexible scaling controls.
- Optimized app settings to remember your API keys and window preferences between starts.
- Added real-time CPU, RAM, and GPU usage monitoring in the status bar.
### Fixed
- Fixed an issue where very quiet audio tracks caused vocal removal to fail.
- Fixed a bug where empty subtitle lines could remain untranslated before voice-over generation.

### New
- Added a video recap feature to automatically summarize long videos [Pro].
- Added AI voice detection to accurately identify male and female speakers using Gemini.
- Added a thumbnail maker to create custom thumbnails with Khmer text styling [Pro].
### Improved
- Improved vocal removal speed and added automatic fallback to original audio if needed.
- Updated the default app theme to a clean Dark style.
- Enhanced gender voice separation to handle lines with both male and female speakers better.
### Fixed
- Fixed an issue with shortcut updates and icon refreshes after installing updates.
- Fixed handling of video length limits for different license plans.

### New
- Added a dedicated window for managing your Gemini API key with step-by-step instructions.
### Improved
- Speeded up video translation significantly by optimizing parallel batch processing and AI settings.
- Updated shortcuts and app names cleanly across updates.
- Refined API key checking for faster and clearer status feedback.
